profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @SoFi @Sofi Tech Solutions
profile.summary:
**Full-Stack Software Engineer**

I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong background in building large-scale applications. My expertise spans distributed systems and machine learning, honed through diverse projects from small apps to enterprise-level systems. I'm passionate about leveraging technology to drive organizational success.

Let's connect to explore how I can contribute to your team’s success.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: REST APIs · Python (Programming Language) · React Native · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Full-Stack Development · Ruby · SQL · API Development · iOS Development · Software Development · Web Applications · Computer Science · Microsoft Azure · Kubernetes

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for CS294 - Unix Terminal

• Mentored and held office hours each week to clarify student doubts regarding assignments and Bash basics .
• Graded assignments which included gdb debugging, networking tools such as ssh,sshfs, nc, bash scripting and version control.

company.name: University of Illinois Chicago College of Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer, UIC
positions.description:
Modernised a legacy application from PHP to Laravel that authorizes and keeps track of rooms, buildings and cabinets access for each person affiliated to College of Engineering in the university. 
Revamped the UI using Vue Js and reconstructed data model of this web app.

Designed RESTful API supporting CRUD functionality along with API authentication that served data to a Vue.js front-end.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Writing and reviewing PHP code for a web app (PhD Eval) in Laravel which keeps track of progress and approval of research for PhD students.

Designed appointment forms for UIC mechanical and industrial engineering graduate students using  php and javascript.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Oaktown 4-H (https://www.oaktown4h.org/about-4-h.html) is a youth organization  where  young people, 5–19, are given opportunities to build confidence, learn responsibility, and develop skills that will last them a lifetime. 
Designed a skeleton website for the organization using HUGO framework which was then taken over by the young children which facilitated easy learning of technologies such as Javascript, HTML, CSS and Git at an early age.

https://oaktown4h-p02.netlify.app/

projects.title: Streaming log data pipeline
projects.description: Streaming Log Data Pipeline to analyze logs generated by applications on AWS EC2 in realtime using Akka, Kafka and Spark and notify stakeholders via an email if relevant logs are found.

projects.title: Cloud Simulations
projects.description:
• Created cloud simulators in Scala for evaluating executions of applications in cloud datacenters with different characteristics and deployment models.
• Simulations for different service models such as IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and FaaS were created and tested using ScalaTest.
